notes: Thirty born-digital papers, five per field. PDFs are not committed; scripts/corpus-fetch.mjs downloads them and checks SHA-256.
No Word-exported PDFs. A Nature Machine Intelligence ethics survey whose Creator was Microsoft Word was rejected.
Economics/finance was chosen over electrical engineering: Quantitative Economics plus q-fin preprints are formula-dense and are what that audience reads.
Physical Review X direct PDFs returned HTTP 403. Wiley pdfdirect and IOP also blocked or returned HTML. Those slots are arXiv copies, noted per paper.
sourceType is publisher-typeset, author-latex-journal (the journal's version of record is still the author's LaTeX), or author-latex-preprint.
tests/fixtures/DDPM_2006.11239.pdf, if present and matching the hash, is an accepted local copy of 2006.11239.
